snippet.title: Oquonie - Playdate gameplay + impressions
snippet.description:
► Subscribe: http://ow.ly/Ozgq50IWo4R
► Follow on Twitter: https://twitter.com/HelloPlaydate
► My Other Channel: http://goo.gl/6GdDjU
--
Destination Playdate is a channel dedicated to coverage of the handheld gaming console from Panic Inc. Hosted by Attack Slug, with 10 years of YouTube experience and 30+ years gaming knowledge.
--
available here: https://play.date/games/oquonie/
--
Take control of the mothership's probe launcher and send probes throughout the asteroid belt to their destinations! Use the power of gravity and orbit mechanics to navigate the harshest environments, swinging around planets, debris and even antiplanets, which push your probe away instead of pulling it in! Will the probes make it to their destinations, or will the space agency be covering your losses until the heat death of the universe?
